question: Name the committee formed for the Village and Small-scale Industries in 1955?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karve Committee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The **Planning Commission (now NITI AAYOG) established the Karve Committee**, a group focused on **rural areas and small-scale industry**, in 1955.
